visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a black blouse and white shorts clutches her stomach while walking with a young man in a black T-shirt and khaki shorts outside a FamilyMart convenience store at night. (2) The woman confronts the man, who is looking at his phone, while they stand under the bright artificial lights of the storefront. (3) A medium close-up shows the woman explaining her distress and pointing towards the store's interior. (4) The man hands her two bottles of 'Will' yogurt drink outside the store. (5) The scene transitions to an indoor living room with a beige curtain and wooden furniture; the woman holds a bottle of the product and drinks it. (6) A Ragdoll cat is shown sniffing the yogurt bottles placed on a wooden cabinet alongside a promotional keychain. (7) Close-up shots highlight the product packaging, specifically the 'Strawberry' and 'Low Fat' variants with a celebrity's face on the label. (8) The woman presents two bottles to the camera with an enthusiastic expression, then displays two pink character keychains.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a faint urban night ambience. A young woman complains of stomach pain with a high-pitched, distressed tone, while a man responds in a flat, conversational voice. Up-tempo electronic pop music starts at a low-to-moderate volume. (2) The woman's voice becomes sharper and louder during a brief comedic confrontation. The music remains steady with a synth-based rhythm. (3) A transition occurs into clear, studio-recorded narration. The woman adopts a professional, energetic, and articulate tone to describe product history and benefits. The BGM ducks slightly but continues throughout. (4) Distinct short-duration SFX like a plastic bottle click and a soft swallowing sound are heard as the narration explains scientific probiotic features. (5) The narration concludes with high-arousal promotional information and a final 'ding' sound effect accompanying a visual presentation of gifts.
